bullets.bullet_text: Generated a new $15M revenue stream by developing proprietary agentic primitives and enterprise solution accelerators, shifting delivery from bespoke consulting to IP-led programs.
Increased gross margins by 20% by deploying governed autonomous workflows that decouple revenue scaling from linear headcount growth.

Optimized $18M in P&L capacity by implementing orchestration layers that streamlined operational workflows and reduced reliance on high-cost legacy outsourcing models, lowering break-even point by 12%.
Scaled the ML engineering practice from 5 to 18 specialists while standardizing hiring, leveling, and delivery playbooks aligned to enterprise adoption and risk expectations.

Collapsed lab-to-live cycle for complex workflows from 6 months to 3 weeks by standardizing intake, evaluation gates, and deployment patterns, enabling real-time automated claims adjudication at scale.

Established a regulatory-aligned GenAI governance model including AI inventory/registry, use-case intake, risk-tiering, ownership, approval gates, and audit artifacts to enable approval of bounded autonomy.

Engineered drift detection and monitoring comparing agent outputs to historical baselines; triggers evaluation rechecks, freezes erratic agents, and escalates to human owners before downstream impact.

Directed a $30M portfolio of digital transformation programs and served as primary commercial architect for Fortune 500 financial institutions migrating to cloud-native data platforms enabling governed analytics and enterprise AI adoption.

Negotiated and established multi-year strategic alliances with major cloud providers to co-sell risk and analytics solutions, generating $15M in incremental partnership revenue while expanding market reach.
Transformed a bespoke regulatory reporting service into a scalable SaaS-like Risk Analytics Platform, increasing client renewal rates by 25% and improving customer lifetime value.
Orchestrated migration of legacy risk frameworks to a unified cloud environment, reducing infrastructure overhead by 30% and achieving 99.9% uptime for mission-critical applications.
Cut regulatory response times by 50% through near-real-time reporting and stronger data governance, eliminating regulatory bottlenecks as a constraint on growth.
Led migrations of monolithic on-premise policy administration systems to AWS architectures, reducing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) by 40% while retiring decades of technical debt.
Re-architected mission-critical underwriting systems for high availability (99.99% uptime) and enabled real-time data ingestion for dynamic risk pricing.
Founded a boutique cloud consultancy modernizing legacy infrastructure for middle-market insurers, enabling cloud-native agility.
Designed SOC 2-aligned cloud controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt modern analytics and ML capabilities previously constrained by legacy infrastructure.
Led a $15M regulatory analytics modernization program for global banks, transforming audit functions into value-added predictive risk capabilities with stronger lineage and controls.
Achieved a 40% reduction in audit remediation costs by implementing automated data lineage and predictive risk modeling across regulatory workflows.
Optimized capital reserve requirements under Solvency II and AG43, reducing redundant capital holdings for insurance clients by 12% while maintaining full compliance.
Engineered high-performance valuation frameworks and deterministic logic systems that established foundational principles for current AI governance and risk architectures.
